pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor"), donor_type AS (SELECT d."Donor", CASE WHEN dc.donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat' ELSE 'One-time' END AS giver_type, d."Amount" FROM donations AS d JOIN donor_counts AS dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"), totals AS (SELECT giver_type, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS donor_count FROM donor_type GROUP BY giver_type), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total FROM totals) SELECT t.giver_type, t.total_amount, t.donor_count, ROUND(100.0 * t.total_amount / NULLIF(NULLIF(o.grand_total, 0), 0), 2) AS percent_of_total FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY t.giver_type NULLS FIRST

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(*) AS donation_count
    FROM
        donations
    GROUP BY
        "Donor"
),
donor_type AS (
    SELECT
        d."Donor",
        CASE
            WHEN dc.donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat'
            ELSE 'One-time'
        END AS giver_type,
        d."Amount"
    FROM
        donations d
    JOIN
        donor_counts dc
        ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        giver_type,
        SUM("Amount") AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS donor_count
    FROM
        donor_type
    GROUP BY
        giver_type
),
overall AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total
    FROM
        totals
)
SELECT
    t.giver_type,
    t.total_amount,
    t.donor_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * t.total_amount / NULLIF(o.grand_total, 0), 2) AS percent_of_total
FROM
    totals t
CROSS JOIN
    overall o
ORDER BY
    t.giver_type;
